item.expected: R-096: "shows three live daily totals ... all formatted with dot separators"; checklist, Layout, theme, visuals and UX: "Long real values — names, titles, amounts, emails — wrap or truncate inside their cell ..." without hiding the information users need.
item.observed: Layout, theme, visuals and UX: on a narrow phone when daily totals exceed the available third-column width, CSS truncates the actual amount with an ellipsis. The owner cannot read the full gross, QRIS or cash figures from the sticky summary, even though checking these totals is a central mobile task.
reproduction_steps: On a narrow phone enter enough stand sales to produce a long multi-digit daily total.
Inspect the three figures next to Simpan in the sticky summary.
When a value exceeds its narrow column it is ellipsized, with no way in the bar to see the full number.
item.surface: Input Harian sticky summary on narrow phones
item.title: Daily totals can be cut off on phones — three truncated amounts share the remaining width beside the save button

item.evidence: App.js:23,31 caches the master including spg_master in localStorage, but :46 initializes spgNames empty and :52 only populates it from GET /spg-names while swallowing errors. InputTab.jsx:32-35 builds its datalist exclusively from spgNames.
item.expected: R-013: "offer the active Master Daftar SPG names as datalist suggestions"; request: "strictly maintaining ... LocalStorage offline-resilient sync".
item.observed: UI state, navigation and interaction: if the owner opens the app offline with previously cached master data, cards load but the staff suggestion list is empty despite the stored active roster. They must manually type names during offline entry, and reconnect alone does not retrigger this effect unless its dependencies change.
reproduction_steps: While online create active names in Master Daftar SPG and let master data cache.
Reopen the already available app without connectivity and open an AMK stand's SPG field.
The cached roster exists but no SPG suggestions are populated.
item.surface: Input Harian SPG autocomplete while offline
item.title: Cached staff suggestions disappear offline — the datalist depends on a separate network request
